title: Endothelial Paracellular Permeability Assay
author: Laura Ruiz Remolina
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j8ccrsw
materials: After 24 h at 37°C remove the inserts and measure the amount of fluorescence in the bottom chambers using a fluorescence plate reader (Fluoroskan Ascent FL; Thermo Electron Corporation, Waltham, MA, USA).

steps.title: Prepare EA.hy926 culture medium
steps.instruction: Culture EA.hy926 cells in DMEM supplemented with 10 % fetal calf serum (FCS) at 37 °C in a 5 % CO₂/95 % air atmosphere.

steps.title: Seed cells onto transwell inserts
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁵ EA.hy926 cells per transwell insert (Corning® Biocoat™ Cell Culture Inserts, Collagen‑coated, Type I Rat Tail, 24‑well, 3 µm pore) and incubate until confluence is reached (≈24 h).

steps.title: Starve and activate cells with LPS
steps.instruction: Starve the confluent monolayers overnight, then add lipopolysaccharide (LPS) to a final concentration of 1 µg ml⁻¹ and incubate for 4 h.

substeps.instruction: Starve cells overnight (replace medium with serum‑free DMEM).
Add LPS (1 µg ml⁻¹) and incubate for 4 h.

steps.title: Add FITC‑Dextran to upper chamber
steps.instruction: Replace the upper‑chamber medium (containing LPS 1 µg ml⁻¹ and soluble endoglin 500 ng ml⁻¹ for the appropriate treatment groups) with FITC‑Dextran (40 kDa) at 1 mg ml⁻¹ prepared in DMEM.

substeps.instruction: Add FITC‑Dextran solution (40 kDa, 1 mg ml⁻¹ in DMEM).

steps.title: Refresh bottom chamber with DMEM
steps.instruction: Replace the medium in the bottom chambers of the transwell inserts with fresh DMEM.
